_comment: Nodes under the root that are NOT exported (TASK-1461), with the reason. A node listed here is dropped with its subtree, its documents, its intents and every edge it is an endpoint of. These are deployment instances of one estate (its own staging and test copies, CI runners, tunnel and LAN proxy), not parts of the product a fresh install has.

exclude_nodes.atlas-api-staging: one estate's staging copy of atlas-api
exclude_nodes.atlas-api-test: one estate's test copy of atlas-api
exclude_nodes.atlas-caddy-lan: one estate's LAN reverse proxy; an install has its own (deploy/oss atlas-tls)
exclude_nodes.atlas-cloudflared: one estate's tunnel to its public host
